chunks: 3209 - When you intend Baghdad, if Allah wills, perform ghusl, cleanse yourself, wear your two pure garments, and visit their two graves. When you come to the grave of Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, say: Peace be upon you, O friend of Allah. Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah. Peace be upon you, O light of Allah in the darknesses of the earth. I have come to you as a visitor, recognizing your right, showing enmity to your enemies, and loyalty to your friends; so intercede for me with your Lord.

Then ask for your need. Then send salutations upon Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام with these same words and call. When you intend to visit him عليه السلام, perform ghusl, cleanse yourself, wear your two pure garments, and say: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, the Imam, the pious, the pure, the pleasing, the well-pleasing, and Your proof over those above the earth and those beneath the soil; a plentiful, growing, pure, blessed, continuous, successive, recurring blessing, like the best of what You have sent upon any of Your friends. Peace be upon you, O friend of Allah. Peace be upon you, O light of Allah. Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Imam of the Godwary, heir to the knowledge of the Prophets, and offspring of the legatees. Peace be upon you, O light of Allah in the darknesses of the earth. I have come to you as a visitor, recognizing your right, showing enmity to your enemies, and loyalty to your friends; so intercede for me with your Lord. Then ask for your need.

Then pray in the dome in which Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام is: four rakʿahs with two taslīms, at his head—two rakʿahs for the visitation of Mūsā عليه السلام and two rakʿahs for the visitation of Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام. Do not pray at the head of Mūsā عليه السلام, for the graves of Quraysh would be facing you, and it is not permissible to take them as a qiblah, if Allah wills.

key_terms.حَاجَتَكَ: Your need or request to be asked for.
key_terms.حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ: Allah’s proof, a title of the Imam.
key_terms.رَكَعَاتٍ: Units of ritual prayer performed for the visitation.
key_terms.قَبْرَيْهِمَا: Their two graves, referring to the two Imams being visited.
key_terms.مُوَالِيًا: Showing loyalty and devotion to the Imam’s allies.

ai.seo_question: What should be recited and done when visiting the graves of Imām Mūsā al-Kāẓim and Imām Muḥammad al-Jawād عليهما السلام in Baghdad?
ai.summary: This text teaches the etiquette and supplications for visiting the graves of Imām Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar and Imām Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليهما السلام in Baghdad. It combines ritual purity, prescribed salutations, affirmation of wilayah and disavowal from enemies, seeking shafa'ah, and specific instructions for the salat of ziyārah.
